data.name: HERETIC
data.detailed_description:
Uncover the Truth Left Behind by the Dead Gods

The gods are dead, but faith endures.

Twisted beliefs continue to shape the world, and anyone who seeks the truth is branded a heretic. Venture into forgotten sanctuaries, uncover the secrets buried beneath centuries of blind devotion, and confront the truth hidden within the age of the dead gods.

The people you encounter and the events you experience are more than background stories. As the truth gradually unfolds, your choices will shape the fate of the world and ultimately lead to one of multiple endings.

A Story Shaped by Your Choices

Every choice you make within the sanctuary carries weight.

Whom will you trust? What truths will you embrace? What will you sacrifice to move forward?

The decisions you make throughout your journey influence both the unfolding narrative and its conclusion, creating a unique story with every playthrough.

Create Powerful Builds

Discover new weapons, skills, relics, and blessings throughout every expedition.

Experiment with countless combinations, uncover devastating synergies, and develop your own combat style. Even with the same starting point, every run can evolve into a completely different experience.

Skill-Based Action Combat

Defeating powerful enemies requires more than superior equipment.

Study enemy attack patterns, dodge with precision, and strike at the perfect moment. Every battle rewards skill, timing, and strategic decision-making.

An Ever-Changing Sanctuary

No two expeditions are alike.

Explore procedurally generated sanctuaries filled with new layouts, enemies, rewards, and challenges. Every journey demands new strategies and encourages experimentation.

Unexpected Events Await

Your journey is filled with unpredictable encounters.

Meet mysterious strangers, accept risky bargains, discover hidden opportunities, or suffer unforeseen consequences. Every event can influence your adventure, forcing you to adapt and reconsider your choices.

Key Features

  • A dark fantasy roguelite action RPG set in a world abandoned by its dead gods

  • A branching narrative with meaningful choices and multiple endings

  • Deep build customization through weapons, skills, relics, and blessings

  • Powerful synergies that create unique combat styles every run

  • Fast-paced, skill-based action combat

  • Procedurally generated sanctuaries with high replayability

  • Dynamic dungeon events that shape every expedition

data.short_description: Faith remains, even after the gods are dead. Branded a heretic, you must explore perilous sanctuaries to uncover a forgotten truth. Master ever-changing battles, craft powerful item and skill synergies, and overcome relentless foes in this dark fantasy roguelite action RPG.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 / AMD Radeon RX 550
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
